capabilities: Hide unlinked mentions in the Backlinks panel
Hide unlinked mentions in the Outgoing Links panel
Configure the toggle separately for each panel in settings
extras: The README's install steps refer to the plugin as "Obsidian Lime" rather than "UnLime", likely a leftover name. The author states it has only been tested on macOS desktop version 1.8.10 and may break with future Obsidian releases.
intentEvidence: toggling the visibility of "Unlinked mentions" sections within standard Obsidian Backlinks and Outgoing Links panels
motivation: The author found unlinked mentions distracting while working with a large vault of diverse notes and wanted a cleaner workspace.
problem: In large vaults, Unlinked mentions produce many false positives that clutter the Backlinks and Outgoing Links panels.
summary: Plugin that toggles the visibility of the Unlinked mentions sections in Obsidian's Backlinks and Outgoing Links panels.
